import unittest
from pathlib import Path
loader = unittest.TestLoader()
suite = unittest.TestSuite()
for path in sorted(Path('tests').glob('test_*.py')):
    if path.stem == 'test_mru':
        continue
    module = __import__('tests.' + path.stem, fromlist=['*'])
    if path.stem == 'test_func':
        for name in ('FIFODecoratorTest', 'LFUDecoratorTest', 'LRUDecoratorTest', 'RRDecoratorTest', 'TTLDecoratorTest'):
            suite.addTests(loader.loadTestsFromTestCase(getattr(module, name)))
    else:
        suite.addTests(loader.loadTestsFromModule(module))
result = unittest.TextTestRunner().run(suite)
raise SystemExit(not result.wasSuccessful())
